decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ The proposed A3 use with takeaway, would result in an over-concentration of A3 uses within the parade, and a general decline in local environmental conditions. The proposal due to its nature, intensity and cumulative effect, would result in an unacceptable loss of residential amenity to the adjoining occupiers by reason of increased noise and disturbance, and cooking odours, contrary to Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1 and S.1.4.

Condition : 2 - 2/ The proposed A3 use with takeaway, due to the failure to provide a refuse storage and service area, or any off-street parking provision for staff and customers or, would fail to meet the Council's parking standards and would be likely to result in illegal on-street parking, and conditions prejudicial to the free-flow of traffic and pedestrian safety in the area, contrary to Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies T.1.4, T.4.4 and S.1.4.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension and change of use from A1 (retail) to A3 (restaurant) incorporating takeaway
